value.title: Memoshipping
value.main_text_excerpt:
Welcome to Memo Shipping - Where Projects Find Safe Harbor
Special projects in the following segments
-  Shortsea
-  Deepsea
-  Breakbulk
-  Barge operations
Market Competence
-   MarineSeamlessly Connecting Waterways, Ensuring Your Cargo's Journey.
-   Oil & GasPrecision in Energy Logistics, From Source to Solution.
-   InfrastructureCrafting Futures with Reliable Project and turn-key Solutions.
-   RenewablesSustainable Solutions, Powering Tomorrow's Innovations.
Safety Beyond Measure: Your Cargo, Our Commitment.
At Memo Shipping, we don't just move cargo; we embark on journeys of trust, innovation, and excellence. With a dynamic and young team, backed by a wealth of broad experience and knowledge, we are your dedicated partners in the intricate world of Shipbroking and Project Cargo.
Anchored in Excellence
Memo Shipping stands as a symbol of excellence in the Shipbroker and Project Cargo industry. We are not just a service provider; we are your partners, your advocates, and your allies. Our portfolio is a testament to our dedication, as we've partnered with clients across diverse sectors, consistently delivering results that redefine industry standards. So, welcome aboard!
Sky is the Limit!
Trust in Memo Shipping, harnessing Norway's long-standing reputation for reliability in the shipping industry. We connect you globally with unparalleled precision and care.
Proud BIMCO Member
Being a member of BIMCO signifies our commitment to upholding the highest standards in the shipping industry. As part of the world's largest international shipping association, we are consistently updated and aligned with the best practices and industry advancements, ensuring our clients receive premier service.
Quality, Health, Safety, and Environment
Memo Shipping has an absolute commitment to remain safe and compliant in all aspects of our business.
Above all, we believe in providing safe and compliant solutions that benefit from a process of performance evaluation and continual improvement. Memo Shipping are certified acc to: ISO 9001, ISO 14001 standards.
